**Capital Market/Treasury Implementation Consultant**
**Role Summary**
We are seeking a Capital Markets/Treasury Implementation Consultant (Senior Consultant level) with experience in Capital Markets and Treasury platform implementation, post-trade operations, and technology transformation. * Participate in the implementation, enhancement, and modernization of Capital Markets and Treasury platforms.
* Support business and technology workstreams across platform configuration, integration, testing, deployment, and production stabilization activities.
* Collaborate with Front Office, Middle Office, Back Office, Operations, Risk, Compliance, and Technology teams to deliver transformation programs.
* Analyze business requirements and translate them into functional and technical solutions.
* Conduct workshops, stakeholder discussions, and gap assessments to identify platform configuration and customization requirements.
* Support trade lifecycle processes including trade capture, confirmations, settlements, reconciliations, accounting, and reporting.
* Assist with system integrations using industry-standard interfaces and messaging protocols.
* Support SIT, UAT, defect management, production validation, and post-implementation activities.
* Prepare project documentation, including business requirements, functional specifications, process flows, and test artifacts.
* Participate in Agile or Waterfall project delivery methodologies and contribute to project governance activities.
* Guide junior team members and support successful workstream execution.

**Required Skills & Experience**
**Capital Markets & Treasury Domain Knowledge**

* Strong understanding of Capital Markets, Treasury, Investment Banking, and Post-Trade Operations.
* Knowledge of trade lifecycle processes including trade capture, confirmations, matching, settlements, accounting, reconciliations, and reporting.
* Experience in trade confirmations, settlement processing, securities operations, SSI management, exception handling, and counterparty management.
* Understanding of operational controls, regulatory reporting, reconciliation processes, and settlement fail management.
* Experience across one or more asset classes including:

+ Foreign Exchange (FX)
+ Fixed Income
+ Equities
+ Money Markets
+ Derivatives (Futures, Swaps, Options)

**Platform & Implementation Experience**

* 5-8 years of experience implementing, configuring, enhancing, supporting, or integrating Capital Markets and Treasury platforms such as:

+ Murex
+ Calypso/Adenza
+ Kondor+/Fusion Kondor
+ Finastra Fusion
+ SunGard Treasury
+ Broadridge Gloss
+ Fidessa
+ MarkitSERV
+ Summit
+ Or equivalent Treasury and Capital Markets platforms

* Experience supporting large-scale transformation, implementation, or modernization programs.
* Ability to conduct gap analysis between business requirements and standard platform capabilities.

**Technical Skills**

* Working knowledge of Java, Python, PL/SQL, .NET, or similar technologies.
* Experience with Oracle, Sybase, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or equivalent databases.
* Unix/Linux shell scripting experience.
* Understanding of enterprise integration frameworks, APIs, XML, MQ, and messaging technologies.
* Knowledge of financial market connectivity standards including SWIFT MT/MX, FIX, ISO 20022, and settlement interfaces.
* Exposure to DevOps, release management, deployment processes, and environment management.
* Experience supporting system integrations, data reconciliations, and operational issue resolution.

**Functional & Consulting Skills**

* Requirements gathering, business analysis, documentation, and stakeholder management.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to propose scalable, configuration-driven solutions.
* Experience facilitating workshops and engaging with business and technology stakeholders.
* Experience supporting SIT, UAT, defect triage, and production validation.
* Ability to review test cases and collaborate with QA and testing teams.
* Familiarity with Agile (Scrum/Kanban) and Waterfall delivery methodologies.
* Strong communication and client-facing consulting skills.
* Ability to independently manage workstreams and mentor junior consultants.

**Desirable Knowledge**

* Experience with market infrastructure and utility platforms such as SWIFT, DTCC, Omgeo CTM, Traiana, MarkitSERV, or equivalent solutions.
* Knowledge of valuation, pricing, risk management, VaR, P&L, and treasury operations workflows.

**Education And Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, Finance, or a related discipline (BE/BTech/MCA preferred).
* MBA (Finance) or relevant financial markets certification is advantageous.
* 5-8 years of experience in Capital Markets, Treasury Technology, Post-Trade Operations, or Financial Services technology implementation.
* Experience working with banks, broker-dealers, custodians, market infrastructure providers, treasury functions, or financial institutions.
* Proven track record of contributing to Capital Markets or Treasury transformation and implementation programs.

**Capital Markets Techno-Functional Business Analyst**
**Role Summary**
We are seeking a Capital Markets Techno-Functional Business Analyst (Senior Consultant level) with experience in Capital Markets, Treasury, and Financial Markets transformation programs. The role requires a blend of business analysis, functional consulting, technology understanding, and stakeholder management capabilities to support platform implementation, integration, migration, and modernization initiatives across Front Office, Middle Office, Back Office, Risk, Finance, and Operations functions. The successful candidate will work closely with business and technology stakeholders to define requirements, design solutions, support testing, and drive the delivery of complex change programs across global financial institutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Business Analysis & Requirements Management**

* Engage with business, operations, risk, finance, and technology stakeholders to elicit, analyze, and document business and functional requirements.
* Facilitate workshops, process walkthroughs, stakeholder interviews, and requirement-gathering sessions.
* Produce high-quality BRDs, FRDs, Functional Specifications, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, and Process Flows.
* Perform gap analysis, impact assessments, process reviews, and future-state operating model design.
* Maintain end-to-end traceability between business requirements, solution design, testing activities, and implementation deliverables.
* Support business readiness, change management, and operational transition activities.

**Capital Markets Functional Analysis**

* Analyze and document Front-to-Back trade lifecycle processes across Capital Markets and Treasury functions.
* Support initiatives involving trade capture, lifecycle management, confirmations, settlements, securities processing, reconciliations, collateral management, corporate actions, accounting, and reporting.
* Collaborate with Operations, Risk, Finance, Compliance, and Technology teams to define business processes and control frameworks.
* Assist in the design and implementation of target-state business processes and operating models.
* Support regulatory, operational, and transformation initiatives impacting Capital Markets functions.

**Technology & Integration Support**

* Act as a liaison between business stakeholders and technology teams to translate requirements into scalable solutions.
* Define functional requirements for platform enhancements, integrations, workflow automation, reporting, and data solutions.
* Analyze upstream and downstream system dependencies, interfaces, and data flows.
* Develop source-to-target mappings, support data analysis activities, and validate business data requirements.
* Support implementation, migration, integration, and platform modernization initiatives across Capital Markets ecosystems.

**Testing & Delivery**

* Create and review test scenarios, test cases, and business test data.
* Support SIT, UAT, regression testing, end-to-end validation, and production verification activities.
* Coordinate defect triage, issue resolution, and stakeholder communication throughout testing cycles.
* Validate delivered functionality against business and regulatory requirements.
* Support deployment planning, implementation activities, and post-production stabilization.

**Domain Experience**
**Required Skills & Experience**

* 5+ years of experience in Capital Markets, Investment Banking, Treasury, or Financial Markets.
* Strong understanding of the end-to-end trade lifecycle.
* Good knowledge of:

+ Trade Capture & Processing
+ Confirmations
+ Settlements
+ Securities Processing
+ Reconciliations
+ Collateral Management
+ Corporate Actions
+ Regulatory & Operational Controls

* Exposure to Front Office, Middle Office, Back Office, Risk, or Operations functions.

**Asset Class Knowledge**
Experience in one or more:
  
  

* Equities
* Fixed Income
* Foreign Exchange (FX)
* Money Markets
* Interest Rate Products
* Credit Products
* Derivatives (Futures, Options, Swaps)

**Platforms & Technology**

* Experience working on Capital Markets and Treasury platform implementation, enhancement, migration, or support programs.
* Exposure to platforms such as:

+ Murex
+ Calypso/Adenza
+ Kondor+
+ Finastra Solutions
+ FIS Quantum
+ Broadridge
+ MarkitSERV
+ Front Arena
+ Other Capital Markets, Treasury, or Post-Trade platforms

* Experience supporting integration, data migration, and platform modernization initiatives.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong SQL and data analysis capabilities.
* Knowledge of Oracle, Sybase, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or similar database technologies.
* Experience performing data mapping, reconciliation, and data validation activities.
* Understanding of APIs, interfaces, messaging frameworks, and system integrations.
* Experience reviewing system impacts across multiple applications and data sources.
* Familiarity with Jira, Agile, Scrum, and related delivery methodologies.
* Experience supporting reporting solutions and business data validation

**Functional & Consulting Skills**

* Strong requirements gathering, business analysis, documentation, and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Ability to engage effectively with senior business and technology stakeholders.
* Experience working within Agile, Waterfall, and global delivery environments.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, workstreams, and project deliverables.
